content.text:
Finding submitted: **deviation** on § 8.2.

- **Term length (12 months)** — acceptable, no change.
- **Price uplift (§ 8.3, lesser of CPI and 3%, 90 days' notice)** — already at our preferred position; not flagged.
- **Non-renewal notice (180 days)** — fails the 60-day fallback and exceeds the 90-day walk-away threshold. Redline shortens it to 30 days and adds a 60-day Vendor renewal reminder, with 60 days offered as a fallback.
